_metadata.notice: ESTIMATE ONLY - Standard Indian Small Animal Veterinary Association (ISAVA) immunization protocol.

vaccination_schedules.notes: Essential puppy primary series. Follow with boosters at 9, 12, and 16 weeks, then annually.
Legally mandatory under Indian municipal corporation pet licensing regulations. Annual booster required.
Recommended for multi-dog homes, shelters, and daycare boarders.
Administered intranasally or subcutaneously prior to social boarding or dog park visits.

vaccination_schedules.protects_against: Feline Viral Rhinotracheitis, Calicivirus, Panleukopenia (Feline Distemper)
vaccination_schedules.notes: Core feline protection. Primary at 8 weeks, booster at 12 and 16 weeks, then annually.
Crucial preventive injection for indoor-outdoor cats across Indian cities.
Recommended after ELISA antibody test for cats with balcony or compound roaming access.
